scene: Schwert des Lebens, eigenständige künstlerische Symbolik zu Johannes 1,4 und 15,1–5; keine historische Rekonstruktion
prompt: Create one original premium botanical-metal illustration for OLIVA, a calm Christian Bible reading companion, not a game. Subject: the symbolic book-sword for the Gospel of John, 'Sword of Life'. A single elegant slender ceremonial sword stands upright vertically, blade pointing upward, hilt at the bottom. The sword symbolizes understanding and guidance, never violence. Entire sword visible with generous transparent breathing room, no cropping. A finely brushed warm silver blade, a very narrow restrained warm gold central inlay, a modest softly curved crossguard in aged pale brass, and a handle wrapped in muted olive-grey linen. One living delicate olive-and-vine shoot gently follows the lower blade, with tiny natural silver-green leaves and one subtle tender new bud. The botanical detail should have the meticulous naturalist quality of a museum botanical plate, with tactile painted metal and linen textures, warm Mediterranean daylight and exquisite quiet materials. Mature premium consumer-app art direction: warm cream/olive/sand palette, subtle gold, refined painterly realism, calm premium craftsmanship, softly modelled dimensionality, carefully restrained highlights. Mobile-friendly strong simple silhouette with sophisticated details visible on zoom. No person, no hands, no blood, no battle, no armor, no trophy, no mystical power beams, no neon, no RPG or fantasy videogame aesthetic, no jewels, no wings, no banner, no lettering or symbols pretending to be scripture, no frame and no pedestal. It is an artistic symbol inspired by John 1:4 and 15:1-5, not an archaeological claim. Transparent background, isolated centered object, portrait composition.
